title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
shortDescription: Work alongside senior AI architects developing computer vision, neural models, LLM fine-tuning, and RAG pipelines.
description: We are seeking an enthusiastic, intellectually curious AI/ML Engineer Intern to join our intelligence team. You will participate in developing production-grade AI pipelines, fine-tuning modern foundation models, experimenting with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and optimizing low-latency inference on edge and cloud clusters.
responsibilities: Assist in training, evaluating, and quantizing machine learning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or ONNX.
Build and test Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma).
Process, clean, and vectorize unstructured multimodal datasets (text, image, and tabular data).
Collaborate with senior engineers to deploy models via high-throughput FastAPI and Docker microservices.
Benchmark model accuracy, latency, and token consumption under rigorous test suites.
requirements: Strong foundational knowledge of Python, NumPy, Pandas, and basic Linear Algebra / Calculus.
Hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, or TensorFlow).
Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or Computer Vision concepts.
Good understanding of Git, version control, and collaborative software development.
Enrolled in or graduate of Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related STEM field.

title: Full-Stack Developer Intern
shortDescription: Build modern, high-performance web applications using Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS.
description: Join our core engineering group to develop scalable, interactive web platforms. You will work on full-stack web applications, integrating PostgreSQL databases, designing responsive UI systems, and ensuring sub-second response times.
responsibilities: Develop responsive, accessible UI components using Next.js App Router, React, and Tailwind CSS.
Build secure RESTful and Server Actions endpoints connecting with Supabase PostgreSQL.
Optimize frontend asset delivery, Core Web Vitals, and client-side caching.
Participate in code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
requirements: Proficiency with JavaScript / TypeScript and modern React hooks.
Understanding of HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, Grid, and Tailwind styling.
Familiarity with SQL databases, relational schemas, and API integration.
Enthusiasm for building clean, user-centric software architectures.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Intern
shortDescription: Scale our inbound brand awareness, technical content marketing, LinkedIn thought leadership, and organic traffic.
description: We are seeking a driven Growth & Digital Marketing Intern to expand DeepLayer Solutions' global presence across enterprise B2B channels, search engines, and technical developer communities.
responsibilities: Execute organic LinkedIn and social outreach campaigns showcasing architectural case studies.
Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and on-page technical SEO optimizations.
Coordinate engineering blog article dissemination across developer portals and tech communities.
Monitor analytics dashboards to evaluate acquisition funnels and subscriber growth.
requirements: Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Understanding of social media marketing, content strategy, and SEO fundamentals.
Analytical mindset with familiarity in Google Analytics or similar metrics platforms.
Self-directed worker capable of thriving in a fast-moving remote environment.

title: B2B Lead Generation & Sales Intern
stipend: Base Stipend + Commission on Qualified Deals
shortDescription: Identify enterprise decision-makers, execute tailored outbound email campaigns, and book high-value discovery calls.
description: DeepLayer Solutions is expanding our enterprise consulting client roster. You will be responsible for identifying high-fit international companies, conducting market research, and executing high-deliverability outbound outreach.
responsibilities: Research prospective enterprise clients requiring AI engineering and software modernization.
Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or verified email tools.
Draft personalized, high-conversion cold outreach sequences and manage prospect follow-ups.
Schedule discovery calls with senior leadership and maintain pipeline CRM hygiene.
requirements: Excellent research capabilities with strong attention to prospect qualification details.
Compelling business writing skills with the ability to articulate software value propositions.
Tenacity, high organizational skills, and persistence in follow-up workflows.
Eagerness to launch a high-impact career in technical B2B sales and business development.
